official: 'Those who answer for {name} spend their days settling quarrels over food, and every week there are more of them.',
official: 'With men called away to the war, {name} has fewer hands than before to see to its own safety.',
trade: 'Much of what {name} earns goes straight to its creditor, and nothing is left over to build with.',
